items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I said, 'There ain't no broad can sing, after Genevieve Stearns, Arcola Cole, and Clara Campbell, there ain't no girl can sing.'

ctx.x: John Hammond had been with Billie Holiday before this?

Oh sure, he had started with Billie Holiday. He was out here on the East Coast; we don't know nothing about this, because like I said, Lester Young was telling me after he came back from Minneapolis and he said, 'Lady J, here's a girl I want you to hear her sing.' I said, 'Lester, I don't care nothing about no singers.' He said, 'But you should hear her sing. She can sing!'
